description: This file defines the AzureBlobStorageOptions class and its validator, which configure and validate options for Azure Blob Storage integration within Orleans. It includes properties for container name, client options, and methods to configure the BlobServiceClient, as well as a validator class for configuration validation.

classes.name: AzureBlobStorageOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for Azure Blob Storage integration, including container name, client options, and methods to configure the BlobServiceClient.

classes.name: AzureBlobStorageOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validator class for AzureBlobStorageOptions, ensuring required properties are set and valid.

methods.name: ConfigureBlobServiceClient
methods.description: Overloaded methods to configure the BlobServiceClient using connection string, URI, or callback.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the AzureBlobStorageOptions instance, checking for proper credentials and valid container and blob names.
